en: The image shows a vintage postcard with two black-and-white photographs. The top photograph depicts a town square or park area with several buildings and a mountainous backdrop. There are paths, a fence, and a few people visible. The lower photograph shows a historic building labeled 'Schießstätte' with ornate architectural features and trees in the foreground. Handwritten text in a European script (likely Slovene or Serbo-Croatian) overlays both images. The printed text includes 'Ferlach, Kärnten' and 'Schießstätte.'
